pick.title: Live monitor
pick.message: Shows the speed and devices online in the notification shade and the status bar, and ends by itself.
pick.replace: Ends the monitor of “{{name}}”: one router at a time.

noWan: The WAN interface has not been read yet. Try again in a moment.
stoppedError: Live monitor stopped: the router's certificate has changed
stoppedSystem: The system ended the live monitor

tips.notifications: The live monitor is a notification: allow notifications first.
tips.promotion: The status bar chip is turned off for RouteLink. You can turn it on in the system settings.
tips.battery: Turn off battery optimisation for RouteLink so the system doesn't end the monitor.

interrupted.text: The system interrupted the live monitor of “{{name}}”. Turning off battery optimisation prevents this.

brand.oneplus: OnePlus: turn on Fluid Cloud for RouteLink in the system settings to see the speed there.
brand.oppo: OPPO: from ColorOS 16, the speed shows in Fluid Cloud.
brand.xiaomi: Xiaomi: HyperOS may show it as a small status bar chip rather than in the Super Island.
brand.vivo: vivo: whether the Origin Island shows it is unknown; the notification is always there.
brand.honor: Honor: status bar chips are for preinstalled apps only; the speed shows in the notification.
brand.huawei: Huawei: status bar chips are not open to other apps; the speed shows in the notification.
brand.samsung: Samsung: the Now Bar skips other apps by default. Turn on “Live notifications for all apps” in the developer options.

notification.sessionExpired: Login expired. Open the app to reconnect
notification.error: Can't read the router, trying again
